title: Terms of Service
advisory.title: Translation
advisory.body: This is a translation for convenience. Only the Italian version of this document is legally binding. Show the Italian version
intro: In short: Use Rootsy honestly and respectfully. Don’t spam, don’t post illegal content, don’t sell your account. The information on the map is provided by the community: always double-check before relying on it for important decisions.
s1.p1: By using Rootsy you accept these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
s2.p1: Rootsy is a platform that connects people with places and communities that speak their language. We provide the service “as is”, with no guarantee of uninterrupted availability.
s3.li1: You must be at least 16 years old (or the minimum legal age in your country).
s3.li2: You are responsible for keeping your password secure.
s3.li3: One account per person. No fake or automated accounts.
s4.li1: Basic: free forever, with limits on some features.
s4.li2: Premium: €4.99/month (or the equivalent in your currency). Billed monthly through Stripe. You can cancel at any time from your profile.
s4.li3: Premium Trial: 14 days free for new users, no card required.
s4.li4: Business: custom plans on request at hello@myrootsy.com.
s4.p1: Refunds: in accordance with EU law (14-day right of withdrawal for distance contracts, which does not apply to a service that has already been used).
s5.p1: When you add a place, a review or a confirmation, you grant Rootsy a non-exclusive licence to publish that content on the platform. You retain ownership of your content.
s5.p2: You are responsible for what you post. The following is prohibited:
s5.li1: Illegal or defamatory content, hate speech.
s5.li4: Uploading documents that do not belong to you to the Document Vault.
s6.p1: We may remove content that violates these Terms and suspend accounts in case of abuse. We will use Gemini AI to pre-filter spam and abuse.
s7.p1: The software, the logo, the name “Rootsy” and the design are our property. Copying them without written permission is prohibited.
s8.p1: The information on the map is provided by the community: always verify before relying on it for important medical, legal or financial decisions. We are not responsible for choices made on the basis of unverified information.
s8.p2: The AI Assistant provides general guidance, not official legal, medical or tax advice. For important decisions, consult a professional.
s9.p1: You can close your account at any time from your profile. We may close your account in the event of a serious breach of these Terms.
s10.p1: These Terms are governed by German law. Place of jurisdiction: Berlin (Germany), without prejudice to EU consumer rights.
